result.stdout:
T4 Studio command line T4 processor
Usage: t4studio [options] input-file
Options:
  -o, --out=file             Output file (default: input.generated.ext)
  -r=VALUE                   Assemblies to reference
  -u=namespace               Namespaces to import <namespace>
  -I=VALUE                   Paths to search for included files
  -P=VALUE                   Paths to search for referenced assemblies
      --dp=VALUE             Directive processor (name!class!assembly)
  -a=VALUE                   Parameters 
                               ([processorName]![directiveName]!name!value)
  -h, -?, --help             Show help
  -c=class                   Preprocess the template into class
